people.role: Head of Trạc Anh Đài since 1080; sea hunter of the frost coast; sworn brother of Băng Tâm's Thẩm Hàn Giang
people.appearance: A thick, quiet man with a seal hunter's squint and a white hide coat, who stands in freezing surf as if it were a warm bath.
people.backstory: Đoàn Thanh Lãng was born in Liên Giang Thành during a cold rain that joined the river by night (A139), the son of seal-oil boilers. At sixteen he went through the river ice and Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang), already a Pavilion man, pulled him out; they swore brotherhood on the ice that winter. He walked the coast to Trạc Anh Đài, where the founder Khuất Thanh Anh (khuat_thanh_anh) taught him to dive in winter and throw the iron. In 1080 the white whale the coast calls the Old Ivory took Khuất under off the terrace. Đoàn held the line until it burned through his palms, and he has led the terrace since. He is a peaceable man who hunts for a living. He keeps the sect neutral, pays the Pavilion its seal oil, and stays out of its quarrels. In 1170 an old woman of Liên Giang told him who her grandson Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) really was, and made him swear to stand by the boy if the coast ever rose. Now his sworn brother wants the Vessel, and the boy is that brother's disciple.
people.wants: To kill the Old Ivory before he dies, and to keep the terrace out of the Pavilion's succession.
people.secret: He knows Liễu Ngư Ca is Hàn Giang's heir and has sworn to fight for him. Thẩm does not know he knows.

people.role: Elder of the terrace; the last monk of Tê Nhạn Quán and keeper of its palm
people.appearance: A bald, bony monk in a fisher's oilskin, who fingers goose-bone beads while gutting fish.
people.backstory: Raised in Tê Nhạn Quán on the marsh, he came to the terrace at ninety-five with his master Chung Quy Nhạn (chung_quy_nhan), the last abbot, when the abbey's disciples were too few to keep it (V086). The fishers took the monks in, and the monks gave them the Hundred Echo Palm. He is the abbey's last monk, and he sits on the terrace each dawn facing the marsh where the geese still roost in the empty halls.

people.backstory: Born on the terrace, the daughter of Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang) and a seal-hunter's widow who drowned in 1130. She dives deeper than any man on the coast and has tamed two fur seals that fish for her. She wants her father to let the Old Ivory go. Ngạc Hải Tiêu (ngac_hai_tieu) wants to kill it and take the terrace after.

people.role: Harpoon captain of the terrace's whaleboats
people.appearance: A big whaler from the Whale Bone Village with a harpoon scar from cheek to collarbone.
people.backstory: He was born in Kình Cốt Thôn the year the Old Ivory took the founder (N-trac_anh-02), and he has believed all his life that the whale is the terrace's shame. He captains its six whaleboats and is the best iron on the coast after Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang). He thinks the head grew soft when he swore off war, and that Đoàn Tố Ba (doan_to_ba) would make the terrace a ferry service.

people.backstory: A seal hunter descended from the oil-boilers Băng Tâm moved out of Sóc Phương Thành (V078). In 830 he gathered the coast's hunters on a terrace of clear water and founded Trạc Anh Đài (A137), teaching that a hunter takes what the sea gives, clear or muddy. He took the coast's first whale, made the harpoon line from its sinew, and was taken in 1080 by the Old Ivory, the one whale he never let go of.

ties.note: held his line
